title: Quantum clock and Newtonian time
summary: An extension of standard quantum mechanics is proposed in which the Newtonian time appearing as a parameter in the unitary evolution operator is replaced with the time shown by a `quantum clock'. Such a clock is defined by the following properties: (a) the time that the clock shows is nondecreasing, (b) the clock ticks at random Newtonian times with random tick sizes, and (c) on average the clock shows the Newtonian time.
